thread:
jia: paging: we're getting a burst of model artifact fetch failures from Hugging Face, started ~10m ago. a bunch of cold starts are spiking to 10-20s and some requests timing out. logs show 429s when downloading model shards. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for incidents channel. Escalation: sam (oncall) -> high.
sam (oncall): ack, I'm on it. initial triage: HF API returning 429 / too many requests. here's a sample error from runtime logs:
```
2026-06-05T14:00:12.341Z ERROR model_fetcher: fetch failed: https://huggingface.co/models/our-onboarded/model-3/resolve/main/pytorch_model.bin 429 Too Many Requests
headers: X-RateLimit-Limit: 60, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, Retry-After: 30
```
jia: confirmed. we see the same pattern across hosted and some Dedicated pools in us-west1. many nodes stuck in cold-start waiting on model artifact fetch.
natalie: any HF status page link?
hf-status-bot: https://status.huggingface.co/ incidents: "Rate limiting on artifact downloads due to cache storm" (note: simulated link).
mike: are these models we host in S3 too? can we redirect fetches to our artifact cache?
jia: yes for a subset — we replicate some artifacts to our CDN/S3. but rollout didn't include model-3 yet (it was supposed to be pulled on first request). high churn cause.
sam (oncall): mitigation plan (short):
- enable aggressive local fallback: if network fetch to HF 429, attempt cached S3 mirror (if available) immediately
- increase retry backoff to use Retry-After header, but don't block request thread — spawn async fetch and return 503+Retry-After for short window for some requests
- temporarily pin routes using model-3 to a smaller local quantized variant to reduce new artifact pulls (runtime config).
- add capacity to onboarding queue so prefetcher can warm replicas gradually.

jia: applying runtime config now: switching model aliases -> model-3: fallback to model-3-quantized-local. pushing config to runtime group prod-serving-1.
```
# devops command
redwoodctl config set /routes/model-3/fallback model-3-quantized-local --env prod
redwoodctl rollout apply --group prod-serving-1
```
ops-bot: rollout started: group=prod-serving-1, id=rl-20260605-1147
mike: created a temporary S3 redirect rule for fetcher service to prefer s3://redwood-artifacts/model-3 if HF returns 429. patching fetcher config.
```
# fetcher config
"sources_priority": ["s3_mirror", "huggingface"]
```

natalie: customer impact note: Hosted API: ~3% 5xx increase for generation endpoints over last 15m; Dedicated: 2 customers in us-west reporting higher cold-starts (SLA alerting not breached yet). recommend Severity: S2.
sam (oncall): agreed S2. notifying CS: @customer-success to prep possible outreach for the two impacted customers.
customer-success (via sam): pinged the two account owners, told them we're investigating and provided ETA ~30m and mitigation steps.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: sam (oncall) will own mitigation for next 30m, then hand to natalie for postmortem + follow up. Use #incidents for updates.

jia: monitoring: switched ~120 nodes to fallback quant model, saw artifact fetch rate drop by 85% and cold-start tail latency drop from p99 18s -> 3.6s within 7m. detailed metrics: https://console.prod.redwood.internal/alerts/1772000456 (internal).
mike: quick note — HF returned Retry-After values of 30s to 120s in some responses. we should incorporate that header into our backoff and prefetch logic.
sam (oncall): good. will keep page open. next steps for post-incident:
- natalie to lead RCA and verify why model-3 wasn't mirrored automatically (owner: storage team)
- infra to add circuit breaker to fetcher: after N 429s in T seconds escalate to mirror-only for that model (owner: eng-runtime)
- product dev: evaluate automatic prewarm for newly onboarded models during rollout
- ops: SLA/customer outreach draft (owner: customer-success)

natalie: taking handoff at 15:00 UTC. i'll collect logs and open a postmortem doc. adding action items to tracker.
sam (oncall): handing off. final status: primary mitigations applied, affected traffic routing to cached artifacts/quant variants, HF still showing partial rate limits but our fallback reduced user impact. continuing monitoring.

ops-bot: Incident update logged: incident_type=third_party_rate_limit, provider=huggingface, mitigation=mirrors+quant-fallback, severity=S2, owners=[sam, natalie], incident_id=INC-20260605-001.

jia: quick config note for follow-up: prefetcher currently runs at low priority for newly onboarded models — propose change to run immediate high-priority prefetch for first N replicas to avoid cache storms. will add proposal to postmortem.

natalie: postmortem draft created: https://docs.internal.redwood/postmortems/INC-20260605-001 (internal). includes timeline, customer impact, and action items.
sam (oncall): thanks everyone. if anything regresses ping me and i'll re-open the page. :thumbsup:

mike: FYI we should also consider temporarily rate-limiting requests that trigger a cold fetch for the next 1 hour to reduce churn. adding to postmortem actions.

incident-bot: auto-close reminder scheduled in 24h if no activity.

natalie: leaving final note: open items assigned, RCA scheduled, CS follow-up template posted. closing handoff.

sam (oncall): resolved for now, monitoring window active.
